title: Apprenticeship Administrator
description:
Apprenticeship Administrator

Are you an exceptionally organised professional with a passion for early careers? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same? If so, our client is looking for a highly motivated Apprenticeship Administrator to join their Early Careers team based in Warwick for a 6-month contract!

Contract Length: 6 months initially
Daily Rate: Up to 300
Location: Warwick (Hybrid Working) (typically 2 days onsite per week, with flexibility during busy periods).

About the Role
As an Apprenticeship Administrator, you will play a pivotal role in managing the lifecycle of approximately 60 apprentices across various programmes. This isn't just an admin role; it's a chance to make a real impact by supporting programme delivery, coordinating exciting events, and facilitating recruitment activities.

What You'll Do:

Apprenticeship Programme Support:
- Track reviews and deadlines, coordinate placement rotations, and monitor learning journeys.
- Chase managers and apprentices for documentation to ensure all deliverables are completed on time.
- Maintain accurate programme records and administration.

Events & Programme Projects:
- Lead logistics for Early Careers events, including Summer Connect and Winter team-building events.
- Manage event planning, speaker coordination, venue arrangements, and attendee bookings.

Recruitment Support:
- Assist the Early Careers Recruitment Lead with assessment centre administration, candidate management, and interview scheduling.
- Coordinate internal and external recruitment events, including university careers fairs.

Who We're Looking For:

Previous experience in Early Careers, including recruitment, apprenticeships, or talent development.
Strong administration and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable chasing actions to drive task completion.

Candidate Background:
Ideal candidates may have experience as:

Early Careers Coordinator
Graduate Recruitment Coordinator
Talent Development Coordinator
HR Coordinator with Early Careers experience

Location & Working Pattern:

Based in Warwick, with a hybrid working model (typically 2 days onsite per week, with flexibility during busy periods).

Join Us Today!
If you're ready to take on a rewarding role that combines administration, event coordination, and recruitment support, we want to hear from you!

Interview Process:
Expect a quick turnaround with a formal face-to-face interview and potentially an informal follow-up conversation.

Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity-apply now to become an integral part of our client's Early Careers team!

Adecco is a disability-confident employer. It is important to us that we run an inclusive and accessible recruitment process to support candidates of all backgrounds and all abilities to apply. Adecco is committed to building a supportive environment for you to explore the next steps in your career. If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage, please let us know and we will be happy to support you.

title: Programme Coordinator
description:
Ready for Your Next Big Career Move?

We're looking for a highly organised and proactive Programme Coordinator to join the West Midlands Growth Company and support the successful delivery of a portfolio of strategic regional programmes. If you enjoy managing multiple priorities, working with a variety of stakeholders, and helping projects run smoothly from planning through to delivery, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.

Who are we?

The West Midlands Growth Company (WMGC) is the region's economic development delivery organisation.

From April 2026, we will lead the delivery of regionally commissioned economic development activity aligned to the West Midlands Growth Plan, working in partnership with the West Midlands Combined Authority and local authorities.

We are building a sharper, business-focused organisation that attracts investment, supports high-growth companies and drives measurable economic impact.

If you want your work to shape how growth is delivered across one of the UK's most important regions, this is your opportunity!

The Role

As our new Programme Coordinator, you'll provide operational, coordination, and administrative support across a range of commissioned programmes and projects. Working closely with programme leads, partners, providers, and stakeholders, you'll help ensure programmes are effectively planned, monitored, governed, and delivered against agreed objectives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with programme support, project coordination, administration, or business support experience who is looking to develop their career in a fast-paced and impactful environment.

You'll Be Involved In:
- Supporting the delivery of strategic regional programmes and commissioned services.
- Coordinating programme activity, documentation, reporting, and governance processes.
- Building effective relationships with internal teams, external providers, and key stakeholders.
- Supporting programme monitoring, performance reporting, and outcome tracking.
- Helping ensure projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and in line with organisational objectives.

What You'll Be Doing
- Coordinating programme plans, action trackers, risk logs, and project documentation.
- Monitoring progress against milestones and supporting programme reporting.
- Organising meetings, workshops, programme boards, and stakeholder communications.
- Producing reports, dashboards, presentations, and meeting documentation.
- Supporting governance activities, compliance requirements, and programme administration.
- Working with programme providers and partners to track performance and outcomes.
- Maintaining accurate records and supporting effective programme oversight.

What You'll Bring

Essential:
- Experience in a programme support, project coordination, administration, or business support role.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building abilities.
- Experience producing reports, tracking actions, and maintaining accurate records.
- High attention to detail and a proactive approach to work.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.
- Educated to A-Level standard or equivalent relevant experience.

Desirable:
- Degree or relevant qualification in project, programme, or business administration.
- Knowledge of programme or project management methodologies such as PRINCE2, Agile, or MSP.
- Experience supporting commissioned programmes, contracts, or service delivery.
- Experience within the public sector or local government environment.
- Experience using project management or reporting tools.

Why You'll Love Working Here
- 26 days holiday
- Company pension scheme including life assurance
- Hybrid working with 2 days in the office
- Cycle to work
- Simple Health employee membership scheme

Equal Opportunities Statement

We're an equal opportunities employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We're committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.
